name: Producer Sakuraba
source:
[Spoiler]An art-house film director who produces works for a very niche audience.

Sickness: Pictophilia: A paraphilia where sexual arousal and satisfaction are dependent upon viewing erotic or obscene visuals, such as pornography, pictures, or films.

An individual who was always obsessed with filming. After being manipulated by [url=/c154428]Yumeno Akika[/url], she decided do actually hang the actresses for the promo picture. 

[Based on the in-game profile]

The producer and director of Dasoku. 

Perished during the 'incident'.[/spoiler]
